quizName: DMV Practice Test #7 40 Questions • Passing Score 30

questions.question: When changing lanes, you should:

options.text: Check your mirrors and look over your shoulder.
Check your mirrors. You only need to look over your shoulder if something seems wrong.
Either check your mirrors or look over your shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check your mirrors and look over your shoulder.
questions.explanation: Before changing lanes, check your mirrors and look over your shoulder to make sure no other vehicles are in your way.

questions.question: How should you brake?
questions.explanation: Always use both brakes when you slow down or stop.

questions.question: A motorcycle's horn is ________ a car's horn.
questions.explanation: A motorcycle's horn is not as loud as other vehicle horns. You can use your horn, but do not rely on it to stay safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Traffic law signs are white with red and black markings. They tell drivers what traffic laws apply in that area. This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: Alcohol reaches the brain ________ being consumed.
questions.explanation: Alcohol reaches the brain within minutes and starts to affect your riding ability. Riding a motorcycle while impaired by alcohol is illegal and dangerous.

questions.question: When riding ________, you face the greatest risk of conflict with other vehicles.
questions.explanation: Intersections are where most conflicts happen between motorcycles and other vehicles. Position your motorcycle so other drivers can see you clearly.

questions.question: You have been drinking alcohol. If you wait one hour for each drink before riding your motorcycle:

options.text: You cannot be arrested for drinking and riding.
Your riding skills will not be affected.
Side effects from drinking may still be present.
You will be okay as long as you ride slowly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Side effects from drinking may still be present.
questions.explanation: Your body removes the alcohol from about one drink per hour. However, alcohol can build up in your body. Even with waiting time, your abilities and judgment can still be impaired.

questions.question: You should keep a larger following distance:

options.text: If the road surface is slippery.
If you can see through the vehicles in front of you to check traffic conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: If the road surface is slippery.
questions.explanation: You need more space if your motorcycle will take longer to stop. Keep at least a four-second distance if the road is slippery, if you cannot see ahead, or if traffic is heavy.

questions.question: When riding in a group, the formation you should use:
questions.explanation: Use a staggered formation when possible. Switch to single-file when turning, entering a highway, or leaving a highway.

questions.question: Stopping while turning is difficult because:

options.text: You have less traction available for stopping when the bike is leaning.
Riders usually focus on the turn and not on braking.
The brakes do not work while turning.

questions.correctAnswerText: You have less traction available for stopping when the bike is leaning.
questions.explanation: You can use both brakes while turning, but it requires care. When the motorcycle leans for a turn, some traction is used for turning. This leaves less traction available for stopping.

questions.question: Your lane position should do all of the following, except:

options.text: Make it easier for other drivers to see you.
Encourage other drivers to share your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Encourage other drivers to share your lane.
questions.explanation: Good lane position gives you several benefits. It helps other drivers see you and lets you see them. It keeps you away from wind gusts, other drivers' blind spots, and road hazards. Your lane position should discourage other drivers from entering your lane and give you a way to escape if danger appears.

questions.question: To reduce the chances of a collision, you should:

options.text: Focus only on your riding, not on your surroundings.

questions.explanation: Bright or reflective clothing makes you more visible to other drivers and reduces your risk of a collision. Always watch the drivers around you so you can predict their next move.

questions.question: A motorcyclist is usually most easily seen by other drivers when riding in which lane position?
questions.explanation: The center lane position is usually best when following a car because it places you in the driver's rearview mirror. Always be ready to change positions if traffic or road conditions require it.

questions.question: What does a solid yellow traffic light mean?

options.text: The light is about to turn red.
The light is about to turn green.
Stop and wait for traffic to pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: The light is about to turn red.
questions.explanation: A solid yellow light warns that the signal will change to red soon. Slow down and stop before the intersection if you can do so safely. If you are already in the intersection when the light turns yellow, continue through it.

questions.question: If you will be carrying a passenger on your motorcycle, you will likely have to:
questions.explanation: A passenger adds extra weight to your motorcycle. You will need to add a few pounds of pressure to your tires before riding. Check your owner's manual for the correct tire pressure.

questions.question: When wearing a protective jacket, it should:

options.text: Be loose and flap in the wind while riding.

questions.explanation: Riding clothing should protect you and keep you comfortable. Jackets and pants should fit snugly so they do not flap in the wind, but not so tight that they limit your movement.

questions.question: When riding at night, keep a minimum following distance of:
questions.explanation: It is hard to judge distances in the dark. Keep at least three seconds of distance between you and the vehicle ahead when riding at night.

questions.question: The most important thing you can do to survive a crash is to:

options.text: Wear a high-quality helmet that is fastened securely.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wear a high-quality helmet that is fastened securely.
questions.explanation: Wearing a high-quality helmet that is fastened securely is the single best way to improve your chances of surviving a crash.

questions.question: Before starting a turn, a motorcyclist should change gears to:

options.text: Prevent power changes in the middle of the turn.
Keep both hands on the handle grips during the turn.
Prevent the motorcycle from slowing down.

questions.correctAnswerText: Prevent power changes in the middle of the turn.
questions.explanation: Change gears before you start a turn. Shifting gears while turning can cause a sudden power change to the rear wheel and make it skid. If you must shift while turning, shift smoothly to avoid skidding.

questions.question: If you borrow a motorcycle, you should:

options.text: Assume all controls are in the same location as on your motorcycle.
Take it out on the highway right away.
Get familiar with it in a controlled area.

questions.correctAnswerText: Get familiar with it in a controlled area.
questions.explanation: Every motorcycle is different. Before riding an unfamiliar motorcycle, learn where all the controls are. Practice in a controlled area to get comfortable with it before riding on the road.

questions.question: What is the best way to handle a tailgater?
questions.explanation: The best way to deal with a tailgater is to let them pass. If you speed up, they will just tailgate you at the higher speed, which is more dangerous.

questions.question: Should you wear gloves while riding a motorcycle?

options.text: Yes. Your hands may get cold while riding.
Yes. They give you a better grip and protect your hands.
No. Gloves can interfere with the controls.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yes. They give you a better grip and protect your hands.
questions.explanation: Wearing gloves while riding gives you a better grip and protects your hands. Use full-fingered gloves made of strong, durable material.

questions.question: What color are service signs?
questions.explanation: Service signs are blue with white letters. They show where you can find rest areas, gas stations, food, and hospitals.

questions.question: When someone passes you on the left, what should you do?

options.text: Ride on the right side of your lane.
Ride in the middle of your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Ride in the middle of your lane.
questions.explanation: When being passed on your left, ride in the middle of your lane. Riding on the right side can be dangerous because the passing driver might re-enter your lane too quickly.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a potential problem?

options.text: An upcoming change in road surface.
Conditions that do not change as you approach them.

questions.correctAnswerText: Conditions that do not change as you approach them.
questions.explanation: Watch for potential problems on the road. Make a plan to reduce their risks.

questions.question: How is alcohol different from other substances?

options.text: It enters the bloodstream very quickly.
It must be digested before entering the bloodstream.
It can improve your riding ability.

questions.correctAnswerText: It enters the bloodstream very quickly.
questions.explanation: Alcohol does not need to be digested before entering the bloodstream. It is absorbed directly through the stomach and small intestine walls, quickly reaching and affecting the brain.

questions.question: How should a properly working motorcycle clutch feel?
questions.explanation: Check your clutch and throttle before riding. The throttle should snap back when you release it, and the clutch should feel tight and smooth.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black letters or symbols. They tell drivers about upcoming road conditions. This sign warns of a divided roadway ahead.

questions.question: What type of footwear should a rider wear?

options.text: Boots or shoes that are below the ankles.
Boots or shoes that cover the ankles.
Boots or shoes made of soft, flexible material.

questions.correctAnswerText: Boots or shoes that cover the ankles.
questions.explanation: Choose sturdy footwear that covers and supports your ankles. The soles should be made of hard, durable, slip-resistant material.

questions.question: What should you do before riding an unfamiliar motorcycle for the first time?

options.text: Just start riding. You learn best by doing.
Just start riding. Most bikes are the same, so you don't need to check the safety features.
Practice the throttle, clutch, and brakes before riding to learn how the bike works.

questions.correctAnswerText: Practice the throttle, clutch, and brakes before riding to learn how the bike works.
questions.explanation: Every bike is different. Do not start riding an unfamiliar motorcycle without first learning how it works. Check the safety and maintenance. Find where everything is located. Practice the throttle, clutch, and brakes to learn its gear pattern.

questions.question: When riding a motorcycle, where should your feet be?
questions.explanation: Keep your feet firmly on the motorcycle's footrests for balance. Do not point your toes downward because they may get caught between the road and the footrests.

questions.question: What should a motorcyclist do when other vehicles are slowed or stopped?

options.text: A motorcyclist should not weave between lanes of traffic.
It is acceptable for a motorcyclist to weave in and out of traffic lanes.
A motorcyclist should ride in a straight line between two lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: A motorcyclist should not weave between lanes of traffic.
questions.explanation: Weaving between stopped or slow vehicles is dangerous. Other vehicles may change lanes, doors may open, or arms may stick out of windows. Motorcycles need the full width of a lane to operate safely.

questions.question: What material should riding gloves be made of?
questions.explanation: Riding gloves should be made of leather or similar durable material to provide the best grip and protection.

questions.question: Which material provides the best protection for motorcycle riders?
questions.explanation: Leather or sturdy synthetic materials provide the greatest protection for motorcycle riders.

questions.question: Which is NOT a reason to keep space between your motorcycle and the vehicle in front?

options.text: It allows you more time to respond to hazards.
It prevents you from finding an escape route.
It provides space to maneuver your motorcycle.

questions.correctAnswerText: It prevents you from finding an escape route.
questions.explanation: Keeping space between you and the vehicle ahead gives you time to respond to problems and room to safely maneuver your motorcycle.

questions.question: What should you do when changing lanes?

options.text: Your mirrors can adequately show you your surroundings.
Turn your head to check blind spots in addition to using your mirrors.
Activate your turn signal and immediately move to the right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your head to check blind spots in addition to using your mirrors.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles have blind spots just like other vehicles. Always turn your head to check your blind spot before changing lanes, in addition to using your mirrors.

questions.question: When should reflective clothing be worn?
questions.explanation: Wear reflective materials at night to increase your visibility. Brightly-colored clothing with reflective materials makes you more visible to other drivers.

questions.question: What should you check before every ride?

options.text: Make sure your bike's brake lights work properly.
Make sure the paint on the bike is not peeling.
Make sure your bike is completely clean.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make sure your bike's brake lights work properly.
questions.explanation: Always do safety checks before riding. Test both brake controls to make sure each one activates the brake lights.

questions.question: Are helmets required for motorcycle riders?
questions.explanation: In Georgia, you must wear a U.S. Department of Transportation-compliant helmet whenever you operate a motorcycle.

questions.question: Which fabric provides the most protection for motorcycle riders?
questions.explanation: Leather jackets and pants provide the greatest protection when riding.
